profile.headline: Experienced Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
•	Highly skilled Senior Software Engineer with over 20+ years of experience in full-stack web development and a proven history of delivering high quality, scalable, and robust software solutions. Seeking to leverage my expertise in Microsoft .NET technologies to lead and contribute to innovative projects that drive business growth and improve user experiences.
•	Experienced in the full life cycle of the software development process and all layers of software architecture.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and critical thinking skills.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Established road maps to successful use of new or existing technologies based on current scenarios & needs based on daily SCRUM / AGILE meetings.
•	Researched new technologies and methods relevant to our existing and future needs, and continuously improved customer experience through writing proof of concept or deployable code.
•	Contributed technical expertise and estimate effort on the stories in Jira.
•	Led and participated in the design, development, and implementation of the company’s NextGen project using C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, MS SQL on Azure, adhering to best practices, coding standards, and architectural guidelines.
•	Implemented CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment (Bitbucket + AWS / Azure DevOps)
•	Maintained unit test coverage of 90% for both UI and back-end code.
•	Wrote Terraform (IaC) scripts for Client Portal project infrastructure setup on demand.
•	Implemented DrFirst Integration (ePrescribing) and got certified.
•	Enhanced and expanded the Case Management System (SaaS/Multi-tenant – Standard Forms, Custom Form Builder, Custom Fields, Document Management, Event Tracking, Permission/Assignment and Tickler/Notifications, Client Duplicate Search and Merge/Delete, Search Persistence and Saved Search, Navigate Away, and SSRS reports) using ASP.NET Web Forms, EF, MS SQL on AWS.
•	Designed & developed billing tools (Payers, Providers, Authorization Packages, Fee Schedules, Coding Rules) using ASP.NET MVC, EF, MS SQL on AWS.
•	Developed a Windows Service for a Billing Validation/Approval Queue Process (Publish/Subscribe with Redis)
•	Developed REST APIs with ASP.NET Web API / ASP.NET Core
•	Developed Caching API (MemoryCache and Redis), and improved system performance.
•	Developed State Forms (DOCX & PDF) Generator using iText and OpenXml SDK.
•	Implemented Single Sign On/Off and Keep Alive / Idle Lockout for HIPAA Compliance
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Angular · Communication · C# · Analytical Skills · Software Development Methodologies · ASP.NET Web API · ASP.NET Core · Technical Design · Problem Solving · Nuget

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked on Texas DPS (Texas Department of Public Safety) projects and delivered results under tight deadlines.
•	Designed & developed Web Services (C#, WCF 4.0) for Criminal History Searches & Clearinghouse. NIEM (National Information Exchange Model) compliant XML format (XML/XSLT)
•	Designed & developed an e-Pay system (.NET 4.0, C#) that handles queuing orders, submission to TPE (payment gateway, web service) and executing the on-approval processes for several DPS applications.
•	Rewrote T.R.I.P. & NIBRS (ColdFusion to .NET 4.0, C#), wrote/executed database conversion process.
•	Daily maintenance for TCIC/NCIC (Texas/National Crime Information Center) process for several DPS applications including Sex Offender Registration
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Communication · C# · Analytical Skills · ASP.NET · Software Development Methodologies · WCF · Problem Solving

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description:
•	DBA for over 30 Microsoft SQL Servers (2000/2005) in multiple data centers. 
•	Performed daily maintenance review, SQL tuning/optimization, disaster recovery planning and testing and custom software database installation support. Collaborated with other DBAs and technical project managers to ensure 24/7 support of all online game databases.
•	Performed weekly maintenance including deploying database patches/updates, executing manual services, re-indexing, and ad-hoc tasks.
•	Planned and performed game server (world) merge and data center migration.
•	Developed Language Search tools for localization team (C# / LINQ to XML)
positions.insights: Skills: Database Administration · Microsoft SQL Server · Problem Solving

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed, tested and maintained Texas Department of Public Safety applications according to established coding standards and best practices (C# / MS SQL 2005 | Sex Offender Registration, Legal Docketing System, TCIC/NCIC Processes, H.E.A.T., and Uniform Crime Reports, Consolidated Response, Clearinghouse)
•	Developed and maintained Sex offender Registration mapping controls (ASP.NET AJAX, ESRI ArcGIS Server API), geocoding modules (TeleAtlas SDK), and daily scheduled process to update ArcSDE database.
•	Website Accessibility with JAWS
•	JIEM (Justice Information Exchange Model) Training/Certification
positions.insights: Skills: ArcGIS Server · C# · ASP.NET · Microsoft SQL Server · Software Development Methodologies · Problem Solving

positions.title: Web Developer (.NET)
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
● Developed "My Account" for real estate website (Searches, Save Searches & Listings, Email Subscription)
● Developed console application for Email Subscription
● Developed internal messaging system with LDAP (Active Directory - Distribution lists)
● Conversion ASP.NET 1.1 to ASP.NET 2.0
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Designed, developed & maintained application (ASP / MS SQL) that controls all the processes, inventories and reports for a refurbishing company
● Implemented automated web-based inventory system out of excel based inventory
● Setup the application to FCI (Federal Correctional Institution) in FL and trained inmates
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Access · Microsoft SQL Server · ASP
